correlation_models.name: Hidden Contamination Property Valuation Discount Engine
correlation_models.rationale: Calculates true fair market value (FMV) by applying environmental impairment discounts (-25% to -85%) for unclosed plume perimeters, unmitigated oil field sumps, and soil vapor intrusion zones concealed in disclosures.

correlation_models.name: Eviction / Foreclosure to Municipal / Public Land Bank Pipeline
correlation_models.rationale: Correlates court-ordered eviction/foreclosure dockets with city tax auctions, code enforcement liens, and redevelopment agency property acquisitions to expose targeted displacement patterns.

correlation_models.name: Fraud Upon the Court / Concealed Environmental Liability Docket Re-Opener
correlation_models.rationale: Matches undisclosed environmental liabilities and suppressed municipal testing against historical civil eviction, quiet title, and eminent domain judgements to establish grounds for Rule 60(b)(4)/(d)(3) motions to vacate.
